build.name: configure + make vtest27 in a genuine i386 userland (configure now selects the MMX/SSE/SSE2 butterflies; no ARCH_OPTION override, no source change)
build.cmd: ./configure >/dev/null 2>&1; make -s vtest27 2>&1 | grep -viE 'warning|deprecated|^a - ' | tail -3; test -x ./vtest27 && echo built

runs.name: Viterbi decode a noisy K=7 convolutional code at Eb/N0 = 3.0 dB (SSE2 code path)
the same code at Eb/N0 = 1.0 dB: more errors survive decoding (the pressure knob)
force the portable C path (-f? no: the PORT decoder is selected by the cpu_mode API; vtest27 has no switch) -- recorded: only the SIMD path is exercised

notes: UNLOCKED 2026-09-13 (batch 06, TECHNE-70): in the 64-bit worlds the package was BLOCKED_PLATFORM (32-bit x86 MMX/SSE assembly, and configure emits -march=x86_64). In the i386 world configure runs unmodified and the assembly assembles; vtest27 encodes 200 random 2048-bit frames with the rate-1/2 K=7 code, adds Gaussian noise at the given Eb/N0 and Viterbi-decodes on the SSE2 butterflies, reporting BER/FER. Oracle: BER at 1.0 dB exceeds BER at 3.0 dB (noise pressure), and the SIMD path reports itself. The batch-03 attempt (ARCH_OPTION override on x86-64) is superseded by this recipe; its receipt stays.
